sources.title: Peptide Characterization and Application Protocols
sources.authority_notes: Bibliographic identity confirmed by owner inspection on 2026-09-11: Gregg B. Fields (ed.), Methods in Molecular Biology vol. 386, Humana Press, 2007. Colin T. Mant, who appears in the third-party filename, is the lead author of Chapter 1 ('HPLC Analysis and Purification of Peptides') and is not the editor. Filename and wrapper metadata from download aggregators is not bibliographic authority and must never be treated as such. The held copy is corrupted: authentic front matter and the beginning of Chapter 1 were observed, after which unrelated material appears. Not citable. A clean replacement copy is required before this source can support published content.
sources.limitations_notes: Authentic front matter and the opening of Chapter 1 only; the remainder is filler. Cannot support any statement, including from the authentic pages, until a complete copy is verified.
